title: Return the registered JPEG MIME type in screenshot data URIs
problem: GetSourceScreenshot prefixes JPEG data encoded with the jpg alias as image/jpg, which is not the registered JPEG media type and is rejected by some consumers.
reproduce: Request a screenshot with imageFormat jpg; the baseline response begins data:image/jpg;base64 instead of data:image/jpeg;base64.
acceptance: Both jpg and jpeg produce image/jpeg while formats such as png and webp retain their corresponding image media types.
repair: Map the Qt jpg writer alias to image/jpeg in a small independently testable helper and use it when constructing the Data URI.

verification.limitations: BCL compiles and executes the production MIME helper and verifies that GetSourceScreenshot uses it. The case does not build or run the complete OBS plugin.
verification.ownerCheck: Request GetSourceScreenshot with imageFormat jpg on OBS and confirm imageData begins data:image/jpeg;base64 and decodes in the previously failing SVG consumer.
